routes.name: Anachronia Teleport: West totem

provenance.detail: Members-only spell; explicit Magic level, rune cost and teleport destination map.
Totem must be installed at this pedestal. Since April 2026 it remains active until removed; no obsolete weekly charging requirement is imposed.

notes: Consumable teleport setting must be enabled; rune counts are declared personal supplies and are not deducted by the picker.

routes.name: Anachronia tablet to Player Lodge

provenance.detail: Members-only tablet; Love Story and tier 2 Player Lodge; explicit destination map. Level 77 Magic is the tablet modification requirement, not a new cast requirement for an already held tablet.

notes: Teleport targets Player Lodge, not the Totem of the Abyss. Tablet is consumed.

routes.name: Menaphos to North Pollnivneach (magic carpet)

fare.detail: Undiscounted fare per leg. 500 with Ali the Trader or worn activated ring of charos; 375 with both. Departure from monkey colony is free.

provenance.detail: RuneScape Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Direct regular network; destination quests; 1000 coins per paid leg. From monkey colony only Shantay Pass and South Pollnivneach, free.

notes: Directed legs preserve the asymmetric monkey-colony service and fares. Discount variants are not inferred.
unknowns: Wiki map anchors identify operators, not observed player landing tiles.

provenance.detail: RuneScape Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Direct regular network; destination quests; 1000 coins per paid leg. From monkey colony only Shantay Pass and South Pollnivneach, free.

notes: Directed legs preserve the asymmetric monkey-colony service and fares. Discount variants are not inferred.
unknowns: Wiki map anchors identify operators, not observed player landing tiles.

routes.name: Shantay Pass gate

provenance.detail: RuneScape Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Members can walk north or south through the gate. The pass item and toll were removed on 26 September 2012.

notes: Connects existing verified north and desert area selectors; no walking-mask changes and no historical item requirement.

networks.detail: Three conditional Totem destinations, two fixed rune spells and Player Lodge tablet; other island teleport methods are unreviewed.

networks.name: Magic carpet
networks.detail: All regular stops connect directly. The monkey colony returns only to Shantay Pass and south Pollnivneach, for free.

provenance.detail: RuneScape Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Direct regular network; destination quests; 1000 coins per paid leg. From monkey colony only Shantay Pass and South Pollnivneach, free.

limitations: Desert/Anachronia supplement is a bounded audit of requested routes, not an exhaustive teleport or carpet census.
Totem destination confirmations are independent personal declarations; no totem placement is inferred from owning a chunk.
No map connection/pin artifacts are rewritten by this supplement.

Carpet fares use the undiscounted 1,000 coins; Ali the Trader and activated ring of charos discounts are recorded but not inferred. Shantay Pass is free in both directions in current RS3; its pass item and toll were removed in 2012.
